scope: Finite retained WM-PolicyEval panels under independent Beta-binomial cell sensitivities with one common effective simulator evidence size for every policy-task cell. The estimand is posterior concordance between independently sampled latent simulator-best and real-best policies, not reliability of an observed-data operational action. With common positive evidence and a symmetric prior, the posterior-mean simulator action is unchanged because every displayed rate receives the same positive affine transform. Evidence sizes are not estimates of the missing simulator denominator and results do not transport.
